data: asset_recommendation_bench: four synthetic repositories, twelve tasks, four hundred source-linked assets

split.group_unit: repository; duplicated source representations stay together

selection_order: highest mean unique required-information coverage on development repositories
quality_analysis: Replay all 400 stored review reports. Only the 80 deliberately defective assets are negative labels. Other assets are unlabelled, never assumed acceptable. Compare equal and legacy dimension aggregation without changing the team threshold.
usage_policy: No fitted decay or actor credibility without longitudinal adjudicated data. One task is one vote. Retain a symmetric shrinkage prior under an explicit single-observation influence budget. Report a posterior interval, not a model accuracy claim.

real_confirmation.budget_scope: bounded confirmation, not a powered superiority trial

prohibitions: No evaluator answers in model context
No publication of private team records
No claiming same-task reruns as independent tasks
